answer: Practically, the chain should require a sealed latency proof from the identity's own host, because vault only stays cheap while a datacenter running 500 clones shows one shared timing fingerprint and gets clustered. Concretely, garden is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any jetty approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
